evidence.observation: H701 reads 328.991 °C, markedly above H702 at 64.199 °C and the reboiler vessel at 53.989 °C.
The large heater-temperature discrepancy persists: H701 330.883 °C, H702 68.449 °C, and vessel 58.077 °C; actual overheating versus a measurement fault is unresolved.

System pressure is 548.161 mbar, column differential pressure 0.900 mbar, buffer differential pressure 1.912 mbar, and cooling-water flow 5.460; no sustained pressure escalation or cooling-flow loss accompanies the temperature discrepancy.

args.missing_evidence: H701 operating setpoint, permitted heater temperature and expected heater-to-vessel temperature difference; independent H701 temperature and heater-power verification to distinguish actual overheating from sensor error. Composition measurements and target criteria are needed to assess separation.
